content:
tess: Uploaded RC artifact rc-2026-03-25-a (gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-a). Quick smoke passed. Planning the 20:30 UTC change window. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-a

omar: good. paste sha and config pin so infra can lock it. any migrations?

tess: sha256:de4f1b3, infra pin: infra:v13-lock. No DB migrations. feature flags: FAST_DECODER=false until post-promo.

lin: short checklist: manifests set, kv-warm executed, canary route staged, dashboards linked?

tess: manifests pushed, kv-warm job 7701 succeeded, canary 2% staged, dashboards in release notes. perf-eval quick run passed.

omar: ops-sheriff are you covering the window? @ops-sheriff

ops-sheriff: covering 20:30 UTC window. fallback is lin. runbook: /runbooks/rc-standard. Pager and #incidents hooked.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion request queued by tess. Prechecks: CI ok, SCA ok, kv-warm ok. Canary scheduled 20:30:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 2% -> 15% in 8m -> 50% in 12m -> 100% if green. Auto-abort gates: 5xx > 0.7% OR p99 > +250ms OR downstream vecstore errors >1%.

tess: staging logs:
```
2026-03-25T19:50:01Z INFO staging start
2026-03-25T19:50:07Z INFO kv warm ok
2026-03-25T19:50:12Z INFO healthcheck ok
```

lin: define rollback exactly so oncall can act without hesitation.

tess: rollback triggers: 1) sustained 5xx >0.7% for 5m, 2) p99 delta >250ms for 10m, 3) token-cost increase >20% for 15m. Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-prev` and patch release-pin configmap.

omar: add downstream embedding timeout >400ms trend for 10m as trigger. ops-sheriff ack?

ops-sheriff: ack and adding auto-deadman at each ramp step for 5m. Also will page if any gate trips.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started at 20:30:03 UTC. rc-a-canary (3 pods). Traffic 2%.

lin: initial metrics good. p95/p99 within expected.

tess: running synthetic prompts: 25/25 success, minor latency variance.

omar: ramp to 15% when you see stability. ops-sheriff?

ops-sheriff: green to ramp.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 15% at 20:38 UTC.

lin: at 15% after 7m: 5xx=0.12%, p99 +60ms, token-cost +5%. downstream vecstore err 0.2%. good to proceed.

tess: proceed to 50% per plan.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 50% at 20:47 UTC. Manual hold for 10m at 50% to eyeball traces.

lin: watching traces, small tail latency on one AZ but not widespread.

omar: prepare final promote command and release note blurb.

tess: final promote plan: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-a && kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-a"}}'`. We'll flip FAST_DECODER after 30m bake.

ops-sheriff: if things go bad roll back to rc-prev with the already-prepared command. Deadman will auto-trigger fallback after 5m if gates trip.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promoting to 100% at 20:58:10 UTC. Pre-promotion checks green.

tess: running promote now.

lin: seeing gradual traffic shift. no spike in 5xx.

omar: release pin updated, changelog entry posted.

ops-sheriff: monitoring post-promo for 30m. oncall ready.

tess: RC promoted and pinned. congrats team :tada:

lin: will post a short follow-up with perf deltas in 12h. closing thread. metadata: promoted-by=tess, sheriff=ops-sheriff, tag=rc-a.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete at 20:59:01 UTC. Live image: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-a.
